reference_id.description: A unique, randomly generated hex value that identifies your web service request.

sub_resource.description: The subresource in the URL accessed by this request.

errors.description: Contains an object specifying each error that occurred. If no errors occurred, the array is empty.

status.description: Contains properties describing the preliminary delivery status of the SMS you sent.

updated_on.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the delivery status was last updated.

code.description: A numeric code indicating the transaction status.

errorObject.title: errorObject
errorObject.description: Contains properties related to an error that occurred during processing of the request.

code.description: A numeric code specifying which error occurred.

description.description: Text describing the error that occurred.
